note: Riverside campground and tubing/paddling outfitter on the Wapsipinicon River at the Hwy 38 bridge just outside Olin, formerly Lou Lou's Landing and now Rolin Wapsi Campground: electric and primitive sites on an open grass loop, tube, kayak and canoe rentals with a shuttle. Sits at river level and has flooded in spring. --Claude
summary: Nothing confirmable: the Lou Lou's website is gone; the place now runs as Rolin Wapsi Campground (Facebook only, no rate, no booking channel beyond phone), and the property is under contract for sale. Criteria flag: likely drop. Not waterfront stands.
flags: CRITERIA (likely drop, your call): loulouslanding.com no longer resolves. The same property (5088 Hwy 38, Olin, the stored pin) now trades as 'Rolin Wapsi Campground' on Facebook ('Offers elec and prim camp sites. River Adventures: Tubes,Kayaks,Canoes Shuttle service.', phone (319) 721-8854, last visible post May 24, 2026). It posts no rate, no site sizes and no way to book other than the phone/email. A real-estate listing for 'Campground On The Wapsi' at that address ('19 electrical hook-up sites plus additional satellite electrical plug-in locations', '50 inner tubes and 20 canoes') shows 'Pending / Under Contract', so the operation may change hands. Whether a 23-ft motorhome can book a night is not stated anywhere I could read; imagery shows an open grass loop with no pads, reachable from the highway.

GATE FACTS (private): no posted rate (old note's '~$12.50/night' came from the dead site); RV Life still lists it as Lou Lou's Landing, 4.5 stars, $ (avg_rate 20), one review (8/2013, $20, 'gets flooded out almost every spring ... the reason for not having water or sewer'). Google: rOlin Wapsi Campground 5.0 (9 reviews); Facebook '100% recommend (9 reviews)'. Not in the Good Sam directory (cached copy). No gateway within 40 km; the family has not stayed. Presence: Facebook page only. Long-stay: nothing published either way.
IDENTITY: name -> Rolin Wapsi Campground, website -> https://www.facebook.com/Rolinwapsicampground/, phone 319-202-5687 -> 319-721-8854 (Facebook and Google). apply.py writes none of these.

DERIVED FACILITIES (showers, laundry, dump) and the 25-site/pull-through counts rest only on the dead Lou Lou's site; the current Facebook page and the sale listing state none of them. Not cleared (not an aggregator), but unconfirmed.

NOT WATERFRONT STANDS: the Wapsipinicon here is a ~60-80 m channel (riverfront width) with a big sandbar, but the camping loop sits 40-60 m from it behind a continuous belt of trees on imagery; the sale listing's 'scenic views overlooking the river' is marketing. A ~2-acre backwater pond lies south of the loop, also behind trees. PIN 42.00730,-91.13980 sits on the camping loop; fine.
